```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
basketball_tibble <- read_excel("data/nba_recruits.xlsx") |>
  mutate(
    tier = factor(
      tier,
      levels = c("Never played", "Brief career", "Solid career", "All-Star level", "Superstar"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    recruit_group = factor(
      recruit_group,
      levels = c("#1–10", "#11–25", "#26–50", "#51–100", "Outside top 100"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
summary(select(basketball_tibble, rank, nba_mean_ws48, top_mean_wa, total_seasons, drafted))
```

```{r}
count(basketball_tibble, tier)
count(basketball_tibble, recruit_group)
```

```{r}
plot_data <- basketball_tibble |>
  filter(!is.na(rank), !is.na(top_mean_wa))

label_data <- plot_data |>
  filter(name %in% c("LeBron James", "James Harden", "Kawhi Leonard", "Draymond Green"))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa, color = tier)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = label_data, aes(label = name), vjust = -0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Recruit rank", y = "Peak Wins Added", color = "Career tier")
```
